verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a document-handling SaaS that uses AI-powered field detection, so asking whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no statement about AI training policy, data-use opt-outs, or training exclusions. The 'secure portal' and webhook signature items concern different subjects and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
